Package com.privatechain.network.rpc

package com.privatechain.network.rpc
Netty TCP server, client, and NDJSON message codec — the transport layer of the P2P networking stack (FR-NET-01, ADR-001).

Classes in this package:

  • NodeServer — Netty ServerBootstrap that accepts inbound peer connections on the configured port. Each accepted connection is checked against AllowlistManager before any message is dispatched (NFR-SEC-04).
  • NodeClient — manages outbound connections to remote peers; used by PeerManager during initial connection and reconnection.
  • MessageCodec — encodes and decodes wire-protocol messages using NDJSON framing (one JSON object per line, terminated by \n). Each message carries a type discriminator field for routing.

The proto/ subdirectory contains the Protobuf IDL (blockchain.proto) reserved for a future gRPC migration (T-B02).

Since:
